title: 約會
description: 約會與感情關係的表達

sentences.en: I was wondering if you'd like to have dinner with me this Friday, at that Italian restaurant everyone's been talking about.
sentences.zh: 我在想你這週五是否願意跟我一起吃晚餐，就在那家大家都在討論的義大利餐廳。

sentences.en: The moment I saw you across the room at the gallery opening, I knew I had to come over and introduce myself.
sentences.zh: 在畫廊開幕式上，我從房間另一頭看到你的那一刻，我就知道我必須過來自我介紹。

sentences.en: What attracted me to you initially was your infectious laugh, but it's your kindness that made me want to know you better.
sentences.zh: 最初吸引我的是你有感染力的笑聲，但讓我想更了解你的是你的善良。

sentences.en: Although we've only been seeing each other for a few weeks, I already feel a connection that I haven't experienced in years.
sentences.zh: 雖然我們才交往幾週，但我已經感受到多年來未曾有過的連結。

sentences.en: The concert tickets I managed to get for next Saturday would be so much more enjoyable if you'd agree to be my date.
sentences.zh: 我設法弄到的下週六演唱會門票，如果你願意當我的約會對象的話會更加愉快。

sentences.en: I think what makes our relationship work so well is the fact that we genuinely respect each other's need for personal space.
sentences.zh: 我認為讓我們的關係如此順利的是我們真心尊重彼此對個人空間的需求。

sentences.en: Before I met you, I had almost given up on finding someone who shares my values and my somewhat unconventional sense of humor.
sentences.zh: 在遇見你之前，我幾乎放棄尋找一個和我有相同價值觀以及有點不拘一格的幽默感的人。

sentences.en: The surprise picnic you organized by the lake last weekend was, without a doubt, one of the most romantic things anyone has done for me.
sentences.zh: 你上週末在湖邊組織的驚喜野餐，毫無疑問是任何人為我做過的最浪漫的事之一。

sentences.en: I've been thinking about where our relationship is heading, and I believe we should have an honest conversation about our future together.
sentences.zh: 我一直在想我們的關係要走向哪裡，我覺得我們應該就共同的未來進行一次坦誠的對話。

sentences.en: What I appreciate most about being with you is that I never have to pretend to be someone I'm not, which is incredibly liberating.
sentences.zh: 跟你在一起我最欣賞的是我永遠不必假裝成不是我的人，這讓人感到無比自在。

sentences.en: The long-distance aspect of our relationship has been challenging, but it's also taught us the importance of communication and trust.
sentences.zh: 我們關係中遠距離的部分一直很有挑戰性，但它也教會了我們溝通和信任的重要性。

sentences.en: I remember the exact moment I realized I was falling for you — it was during that rainy afternoon we spent at the bookstore.
sentences.zh: 我記得我意識到自己愛上你的確切時刻——就是我們在書店度過的那個下雨的午後。

sentences.en: If you're comfortable with it, I'd love to introduce you to my family this holiday season, since they've been eager to meet you.
sentences.zh: 如果你覺得可以的話，我很想在這個假期介紹你給我的家人認識，因為他們一直渴望見到你。

sentences.en: The fact that we can sit in comfortable silence together, without feeling the need to fill every moment with words, says a lot about us.
sentences.zh: 我們能一起坐在舒適的沉默中，不覺得需要用言語填滿每一刻，這說明了我們之間的關係。

sentences.en: I never imagined that a chance encounter at a coffee shop would lead to the most meaningful relationship I've ever had in my life.
sentences.zh: 我從未想過在咖啡店的一次偶遇會帶來我人生中最有意義的一段感情。

sentences.en: Although our first date was awkward in many ways, looking back on it now, I wouldn't change a single thing about that evening.
sentences.zh: 雖然我們的第一次約會在很多方面都很尷尬，但現在回想起來，那個晚上我一點都不會想改變。

sentences.en: The way you remembered that small detail I mentioned weeks ago shows me how much you truly listen and care about what I say.
sentences.zh: 你記住了我幾週前提到的那個小細節，這讓我看到你真的有在聽而且在乎我說的話。

sentences.en: I think we should take things slowly and enjoy getting to know each other, rather than rushing into something we're not ready for.
sentences.zh: 我覺得我們應該慢慢來，享受互相認識的過程，而不是匆忙進入我們還沒準備好的事情。

sentences.en: Being in a healthy relationship, one built on mutual respect and open communication, has positively transformed every aspect of my life.
sentences.zh: 處在一段健康的關係中——建立在相互尊重和開放溝通之上——正面地改變了我生活的每一個面向。

sentences.en: The flowers you sent to my office today completely caught me off guard, and my colleagues haven't stopped teasing me about it.
sentences.zh: 你今天送到我辦公室的花完全出乎我意料，我的同事們一直在取笑我這件事。

sentences.en: I've learned from past relationships that honesty, even when it's uncomfortable, is always better than avoiding difficult conversations.
sentences.zh: 我從過去的感情中學到，誠實即使讓人不舒服，也總是比逃避困難的對話來得好。

sentences.en: Would you be interested in taking a cooking class together, since we both love food and it could be a fun way to spend our evenings?
sentences.zh: 你有興趣一起上烹飪課嗎？因為我們都愛吃，這可以是一個有趣的方式來度過我們的晚上。

sentences.en: The playlist you made for me, which perfectly captures the story of how we met, is something I listen to almost every single day.
sentences.zh: 你為我做的播放清單完美地記錄了我們相遇的故事，我幾乎每天都會聽。

sentences.en: I admire how you always encourage me to pursue my dreams, even when it means we'll have less time to spend together.
sentences.zh: 我很佩服你總是鼓勵我追求夢想，即使這意味著我們在一起的時間會更少。

sentences.en: The trust we've built over these past months didn't come easily, but it's something I value more than I can possibly express.
sentences.zh: 我們在過去幾個月建立的信任來之不易，但它是我難以言表地珍視的東西。

sentences.en: I have to admit that meeting your parents for the first time made me more nervous than any job interview I've ever had.
sentences.zh: 我必須承認第一次見你父母讓我比任何一次工作面試都更緊張。

sentences.en: What we have together, this beautiful partnership based on love and friendship, is exactly what I always hoped to find someday.
sentences.zh: 我們在一起擁有的——這段建立在愛和友誼上的美好夥伴關係——正是我一直希望有一天能找到的。

sentences.en: The weekend getaway you planned for our anniversary was thoughtful in every detail, from the restaurant choice to the sunset walk.
sentences.zh: 你為我們紀念日計劃的週末小旅行在每個細節上都很用心，從餐廳的選擇到日落散步。

sentences.en: I believe that a strong relationship requires both partners to grow individually while also nurturing what they've built together.
sentences.zh: 我相信一段堅強的關係需要雙方各自成長，同時也要培養他們一起建立的東西。

sentences.en: Looking at how far we've come since that nervous first date at the café, I feel incredibly grateful for every moment we've shared.
sentences.zh: 回顧從咖啡廳那次緊張的第一次約會以來我們走了多遠，我對我們分享的每一刻都感到無比感恩。
